fileLabel: Label part of the filename. {objectName} is replace by the name of the object, region, or by the id of th subdivision. {platform} is replaced by Terra. {thisDate} is replaced by the formatted date for the records within the file, being day, or month; NB: gap files contain 3 months, but the filename only contain the middle month; the stat files aggregate all the stats per subdivision and the filename doesnt have a date. {version} is replaced by v006, although the version of the modis data is v6.1.
fileSubDirectory3: For data directories, this may be used to indicate the version of collection: {versionOfDataCollection}
fileSubDirectory4: For some labels, there are a lot of objects (e.g. regional stats for subdivisions). The fileSubDirectory3 allow to spread them in subfolders. When used, {objectName_1000} is replaced by the id of the subdivision / 1000, floored.
objectDependent: 1: the file depends on an object, region, tile, or subdivision.
dateDependent: 1: the file depends on a date, this is typical of data files, except for subdivision regional stats
webDirectory: Directory in the nusnow ingest platform to put the files for ingestion by snow-today website.
webFileLabel: For the ingest by snow-today website. Web file name is obtained by concatening this label to the file extension.
